description: This file defines the Subordinate class, which extends ListableDisplayField, and provides specific implementations for methods such as getDtoClass, getFields, and getEntityAliases related to subordinate display fields in the reporting system of the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: Represents a subordinate display field in the reporting system, inheriting from ListableDisplayField and defining specific methods related to subordinate data representation.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, specifically for subordinate data.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant to the subordinate display, in this case the employee number.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the database entity alias used within queries for subordinate data.
